note: Russell County KY PVA publishes parcels only through the Schneider qPublic/Beacon viewer; no public ArcGIS REST service or parcel file found. qPublic, Beacon and russellpva.com return bot-check 403 pages to automated access. ArcGIS Hub/Online, KY state GIS (kygisserver, KyGovMaps) and the KYTC PVA layer had no Russell County parcel service. Only commercial parcel files (Regrid, Dynamo, Mapping Solutions, Acres) exist.
